_note: 15 diagnostic questions, 5 per subject, each tagged to a skill and a difficulty (0..1). Answers are worked in 'explain'. g = 9.8 m/s^2.

questions.subject: physics
questions.prompt: A car speeds up from 0 to 20 m/s in 5.0 s. What is its acceleration?

questions.subject: physics
questions.prompt: Up is positive. A stone is dropped from rest. What is its velocity after 1.5 s?

questions.subject: physics
questions.prompt: A 3.0 kg cart has a net force of 12 N on it. What is its acceleration?

questions.subject: physics
questions.prompt: A 5.0 kg box sits on a 20° incline. What is the normal force on it?
questions.explain: N = mg cos 20° = 49 × 0.940 ≈ 46 N. 49 N is mg; 17 N is mg sin 20°.

questions.subject: physics
questions.prompt: How much work is done lifting a 2.0 kg book 1.5 m at constant speed?

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.prompt: What is the molar mass of CO₂? (C = 12.01, O = 16.00 g/mol)

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.prompt: How many grams are in 0.50 mol of NaCl? (NaCl = 58.44 g/mol)

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.prompt: N₂ + 3H₂ → 2NH₃. How many moles of NH₃ form from 6.0 mol of H₂, with N₂ in excess?
questions.explain: 6.0 mol H₂ × (2 mol NH₃ / 3 mol H₂) = 4.0 mol.

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.prompt: CH₄ + 2O₂ → CO₂ + 2H₂O. How many grams of O₂ react with 1.0 mol of CH₄? (O₂ = 32.00 g/mol)
questions.explain: 1.0 mol CH₄ needs 2.0 mol O₂; 2.0 × 32.00 = 64 g.

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.prompt: A solution has [H⁺] = 1 × 10⁻³ mol/L. What is its pH?

questions.subject: biology
questions.prompt: Which molecule carries the genetic code from the nucleus to the ribosome?
questions.explain: Messenger RNA (mRNA) carries the code; tRNA brings amino acids; rRNA is part of the ribosome.

questions.subject: biology
questions.prompt: The template strand is 3′-TAC CCG-5′. What is the mRNA?
questions.explain: Pair each base, A→U, T→A, C→G, G→C: TAC → AUG and CCG → GGC.

questions.subject: biology
questions.prompt: Aa × Aa. What fraction of the offspring show the recessive trait?
questions.explain: The Punnett square gives AA, Aa, Aa, aa; only aa (1 in 4) shows the recessive trait.

questions.subject: biology
questions.prompt: Aa × aa. What fraction of the offspring are heterozygous?
questions.explain: Aa × aa gives Aa, Aa, aa, aa: half are heterozygous.

questions.subject: biology
questions.prompt: Which organelle makes most of a cell’s ATP?
questions.explain: Mitochondria carry out aerobic respiration, which makes most of the ATP.
